description: Permissions for Brume's chrome. Scoped to chrome webviews only - see below.
//windows: Every Brume window: `main` and then `win-2`, `win-3`. A window here only decides which windows the capability can apply in; the webview list below is what actually keeps it off the page.
//: SECURITY: this must never match a content webview. Those render arbitrary websites, and any capability granted to one is granted to every page the user visits. Chrome webviews are `chrome-<window>` and content webviews are `tab-<id>`, so `chrome-*` cannot match a content webview as long as those two namings stay disjoint. That is enforced in browser.rs, where WindowState::chrome builds the label and the tab labels are built beside it. Tauri 2 denies by default, so anything not matched here has nothing.
